operating_notes.text: Withdrew preferential issue of up to 15,34,50,146 shares for 21.62% stake in Automech Group Holding due to SEBI 15-day timeline constraint vs ADGM regulatory approvals.

timeline.summary: Rama Steel Tubes withdrew its proposed preferential issue of up to 15,34,50,146 equity shares for acquiring 21.62% of Automech Group Holding due to cross-border procedural constraints.
Rama Steel Tubes Limited held an Extraordinary General Meeting on 21-10-2026, passed 2 special resolutions, with 95.21% promoter votes and 98.82% public votes.
